notes: Strong keystone: the opening measures 602 px wide at y=320 and 504 px at y=1390, so leaf edges converge downward and all x fractions were taken against the LOCAL leaf width at each feature's height, not against the recorded bbox. Frame is the same navy as the leaf, so the whole assembly reads as one dark mass against white plaster. Steepest vertical falloff in the set - a corridor light directly above gives contrast 10.6, top of the leaf #616879 and the foot #0B0A17, and the near reveal follows it down from tone 0.92 at the top to 0.13 at the floor. Two raised moulded panels: upper y 0.09-0.61, lower y 0.71-0.91, both about x 0.24-0.77.
